svg.text: STAGING — SHEET 1 · FREE PUBLIC UAT STACK
Render hosts the container, Neon keeps the data — both free, both in Singapore
Frontend and backend ship as ONE container on ONE origin, as deploy_gcp.sh already does. No CORS, and the login cookie stays first-party.
Sign in: test account, or an
Pick 16 to match Cloud SQL debt-pg-stg
Scales to zero after 5 min idle
one row per browser session and key
+psycopg is required: psycopg2 is not installed

Env vars on Render: ENV=uat · DATABASE_URL · AUTH_MODE=on · AUTH_ALLOW_TEST_ACCOUNTS=true · AUTH_SESSION_SECRET (new, not the laptop's) · AUTH_TEST_ACCOUNTS · AUTH_ALLOWLIST · GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (later)
ERP credentials never leave Volt-owned infrastructure.
• The first request after 15 idle minutes waits about a minute while Render wakes up
• 750 free instance-hours a month per workspace: one always-on service fits
• 512 MB: a 25 MB xlsx upload can run out of memory — keep test files small
• Free tiers carry no SLA. Fine for UAT, never for live collection work
